evidence.title: Toolcraft – Build your own design apps with AI.
GitHub - pixel-point/toolcraft: Build your own design apps with AI. · GitHub

name: Toolcraft
summary: Open-source starter kit and UI library for building custom design apps with an AI coding agent.
description: A starter app plus a UI library for building small creative tools: a canvas with pan and zoom, controls and panels, sliders, color and font pickers, layers, animation timeline and keyframes, and image/video export. Scaffolded by the CLI or by prompting an AI agent; built with TanStack Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Base UI. Includes example apps, agent skills and acceptance checks.
contains: starter app, UI library and AI harness copied into your project
runtime: canvas with pan/zoom, controls, panels, layers, timeline, keyframes, image/video export
controls: slider, range, select, switch, checkbox, color, gradient, font picker, uploads, canvas, layers, toolbar
stack: TanStack Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Base UI
example app gallery: Liquid Metal, Mesh FX, Dither Lab, Suminagashi Studio and more
works with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor or another coding agent
checks: unit, browser, acceptance and performance tests
MIT licensed, free for commercial projects
